handoff_amendment: 2026-10-02: apply codegen-quality-plan section 11's newer, stricter protection literally. Explicit frame-pointer requests and kernel markers suppress ALL three frame variants, not just leaf-frame elision. This narrows the opt-in population until kernel validation; it changes no baseline or acceptance threshold.
slice: Frame and call overhead, first slice: opt-in paired saves, one shared epilogue and leaf-frame elision
baseline_qualification: Clean HEAD after N03a closure. The release compiler at this commit is the options-off reference. N03a retained baseline objects were deleted at its closure, so fresh A/B six-unit objects and both 384-case native object sets are re-recorded at this commit before any frame code changes.
authority: docs/target-spec.md sections 2-4 (abi-<os> frame facts, profile-kernel) and row B4
docs/evomir-spec.md section 6 (frame layout, dynamic and over-aligned frames, variadic save areas) and section 8 (emission)
scope: Three emission-only frame variants in the AArch64 module, each behind an explicit code-generation option that defaults OFF. No frame layout, slot offset, frame size, save-area order, callee-saved set, allocation decision, instruction selection outside prologue/epilogue/return emission, EvoIR semantics, registry, checker or interpreter changes. No default flip.

motivation.census: B-unchecked prologue_epilogue bytes versus GCC-14 -O2: deflate 4,608/860; inflate 2,100/392; zstd compress 28,164/4,672; zstd decompress 10,688/1,744; cJSON 8,336/1,744; total 53,896/9,412.
motivation.composition_method: Exploration only, not a receipt: arm-A unchecked assembly text of the six units at fb02b7e3, counted per function between .type and .size. Totals reproduce the census instruction counts (deflate 1,152 x 4 = 4,608 bytes).
motivation.ranking: Repeated per-return epilogues (F2) are the largest lever (estimated 3,734 of 7,073 prologue/epilogue instructions in zstd compress), then pairing (F1), then frameless leaves (F3, 55 functions in zstd compress). Estimates are syntactic ceilings; measured S1 bytes decide.
motivation.f4_decision: SKIPPED: the current layout puts the frame record above the save area, so stp/ldp pre/post-index folding of the stack adjustment would move offsets. The only layout-preserving form found (restoring sp from x29 for frames above 4,095 bytes) touches one function in the six units. Not worth a sub-step.

options.driver_flag: --frame-opt=LIST, LIST a comma-separated subset of paired-saves, shared-epilogue, leaf-frames; at most once per command; each name at most once; unknown names rejected; refused with --check like --ub-checks. The exact-input evo-ir-asm adapter accepts the same --frame-opt=LIST.
options.codegen_fields: CodegenOptions.frame: FrameVariants { paired_saves, shared_epilogue, leaf_frames } (all false by default), frame_pointer_required and leaf_frame_pointer_required (both false by default).
options.frame_pointer_requests: -fno-omit-frame-pointer sets frame_pointer_required, -fomit-frame-pointer clears that request (last wins). -mno-omit-leaf-frame-pointer is newly admitted and sets an independent leaf request. Either request suppresses all frame variants under the newer section 11 handoff restriction.
options.kernel_profile: Kernel-profile markers suppress all frame variants: -mgeneral-regs-only (unconditional in arm64 Kbuild), -mstack-protector-guard=sysreg, or a nonzero patchable entry on the function. The kernel command projection (tools/k1/cmdrecord.py) does not pass --frame-opt, so kernel objects keep today's output.
options.identity: When any frame variant is requested, the assembly header records the canonical requested list beside the existing evocc-native-ub-checks line. Per-function eligibility and protection can decline it. With every variant off the emitted text is unchanged.
options.default: OFF for every sub-step in this slice.

sub_steps.name: paired-saves
sub_steps.change: In prologue and epilogue, two callee-saved general registers whose save slots are adjacent (offsets o and o+8, o a multiple of 8 and o <= 504, frame not dynamic) are saved with one stp and restored with one ldp. The saved vector low halves (d8-d15, partially preserved) pair the same way. Unpaired or out-of-range slots keep today's str/ldr. No offset changes.
sub_steps.cfi: Under unwind tables each register of a pair gets its own .cfi_offset (or DW_CFA_expression for over-aligned frames) after the stp and its own .cfi_restore after the ldp.
sub_steps.red: Focused tests asserting stp/ldp of adjacent saves at the unchanged offsets, odd remainders, out-of-range and dynamic fallbacks, CFI per register; driver test that --frame-opt=paired-saves is accepted. Fails before implementation on the missing option.

sub_steps.name: shared-epilogue
sub_steps.change: When a function has at least two Ret terminators and the per-return sequence (guard check, restores, stack restore, frame-record pop, autiasp, ret) is longer than one instruction, emit it once at the last Ret in layout order behind a local label; every other Ret becomes one unconditional b to that label.
sub_steps.invariants: Every return still executes the complete guard check (when the function is protected) before any restore; autiasp still follows the restore of the same sp; CFI remember/restore state brackets the single epilogue; the shared label is unique per function and survives the long-branch re-emission; unconditional b reach (128 MiB) exceeds any function the relaxation threshold admits.
sub_steps.red: Focused tests: one ret per multi-return function, every other return branches to the label, guard check emitted once and dominating the restores, pac-ret order, unwind state directives, relaxation re-emission keeps one label, single-return functions unchanged.

sub_steps.name: leaf-frames
sub_steps.change: Omit the frame record (stp x29,x30 / mov x29,sp / ldp x29,x30 and their CFI) for a function with no calls, frame size zero (no callee-saved registers, slots, spills, outgoing or variadic areas), no dynamic allocation or release, no stack guard, no inline assembly, no incoming stack argument and no frame-address/return-address/ancestor/incoming-stack/save-area reads.
sub_steps.forbidden_when: frame_pointer_required (-fno-omit-frame-pointer), the leaf request (-mno-omit-leaf-frame-pointer), general-registers-only, a sysreg stack guard, or a nonzero patchable entry. pac-ret keeps paciasp/autiasp around the frameless body. Unwind tables keep the default CFA (sp+0).
sub_steps.spec: EvoMIR revision text restates 'every function keeps a frame pointer' as the default rule and adds the opt-in exception with its complete forbidden list.
sub_steps.red: Focused tests: eligible leaf has no frame record; each forbidding condition keeps it; the requesting options and the kernel markers keep today's text.

baselines.six_units: Re-record arms A (no EqSat) and B (P0 verified chain) at the plan commit with tests/contracts/codegen-n03f-baseline-{a,b}-20261002.json (retain_object_baseline=true, extra_flags=[]); both profiles; three compiles and two assembled twins per unit/profile through the existing Capture/S1 path.
baselines.native_corpora: Record Darwin and Linux 384-case objects with EVOCC_MIR_OBJECT_CAPTURE_MODE=record into .evidence/codegen/n03f-corpus-20261002/ (section9_c_corpus.rs and the ignored whole-corpus test in section8_linux_profile.rs).
baselines.options_off_identity: After the last kept sub-step: regression plans codegen-n03f-regression-{a,b}-20261002.json (extra_flags=[], object_baseline_receipt = the baseline captures, frozen when their hashes exist) and both corpora in compare mode. Zero changed object bytes is required; any difference not caused by the change is a stop.

validation_options_on.mechanism: Six units: measurement plans with extra_flags. Native tests: an opt-in test-support variable EVOCC_MIR_FRAME_OPT=LIST read only by test code; unset keeps the existing call path byte-for-byte.
required: Allocation verifier and MIR validator unchanged (they run before emission) and the existing evocc-mir suites green.
Darwin 384-case and Linux 384-case corpora with EVOCC_MIR_FRAME_OPT set: every case executes and agrees; options-on twins byte-identical (record mode into a separate capture root).
Six-unit correctness harnesses through tests/contracts/codegen-n03f-on-*.json (zlib compress/decompress, zstd compress/decompress, cJSON round trip, integer-mix) in both profiles.

Calling-convention probes, record and variadic native tests with EVOCC_MIR_FRAME_OPT set: section9_calling_convention_probe, section6_records, section9_lowering_frontier_corpus (variadic callee, named stack, forwarding), section9_activation_addresses_natively.

Targeted interaction tests: unwind tables (CFI per paired register, backtrace through over-aligned and dynamic frames), stack guard global (exit 0 and 77 through __stack_chk_fail) and sysreg (text), pac-ret, over-aligned and dynamic frames, variadic functions, return_address/frame_address users, general-registers-only, patchable entries; executed under GCC-14 in the sealed container where executable.
Kernel-profile markers and frame-pointer requests with leaf-frames requested produce today's frame records.

measurement.metric: Per unit and profile, S1 .text + .text.* bytes and static instruction slots, options off versus on, cumulative per sub-step; prologue_epilogue (and every other) N01 category through tools/ladder/codegen_census.py analyze() with the frozen N01 disassembler identity; ratio to the frozen GCC-14 -O2 bytes of the S5 reference receipt.
measurement.reporting: Per unit; checked and unchecked separately; no cross-family average. A unit that grows is a recorded regression. Two builds byte-identical for every measured object. Compile time is observed, not a new bound; interpreter steps are unaffected by emission and recorded through the existing steps command.
measurement.expected_direction: prologue_epilogue bytes down on every library unit; branch bytes up by at most one b per removed return copy.

resources.retention: Baseline objects only until the options-off comparisons close; options-on retained objects only until the census summary is written; then delete and keep hashes, category tables and logs. No new target tree, workspace clone, kernel tree or VM disk. Never delete contracts, sealed fixtures, open-task evidence or lean/.lake. Record the net disk change.

stop_rule: Stop on: any need to change default behavior, EvoIR semantics, a registry or an ABI rule; options-off object bytes differing from the baseline without a root cause in this change; disk below 15 GiB after cleaning own intermediates. A correctness failure with options on that cannot be fixed inside frame code reverts that sub-step with its minimal reproducer recorded, and the others continue. An unavailable Linux lane is NOT_RUN with the exact error, never PASS.
admission: Defaults stay OFF in this slice. The close-out proposes, per sub-step, whether evidence suffices for a later default flip; the flip itself is separate work with its own owner decision.
claim_ceiling: Opt-in, emission-only frame variants validated on the stated populations (six units with original harnesses, 384+384 native corpora, probes and targeted interactions). Not a default change, not a proved backend, not a latency result, not GCC parity, not kernel acceptance.
